summary: Tron Inc. filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing a sales agreement with Clear Street LLC for an at-the-market offering of common stock under Rule 415(a)(4). Clear Street acts as agent and/or principal, earning up to 3% commission on gross proceeds, with sales at company discretion and no obligation to sell. Shares issue under an existing Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-288986). Either party may terminate on ten days' notice. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; no price, stake, or premium terms are stated. Watch for dilution and overhang.
